method: Every npm name in dshworks/awesome-dsh-plugins data/plugins.json at commit e2732b53db; the manifest npm tags latest, read once; dsh's install gate as ported in scripts/measure-installability.mjs applied to that one manifest set at 0.2.1-rc.5 and at 0.2.2-rc.1. Five verdicts were re-checked with the real dsh 0.2.2-rc.1 CLI (dsh plugin add) and all five agreed. Downloads are npm's last-month point counts.
